summary: The diff replaces the not-implemented stub in Atomics.xor with a closure that calls byte_list_bitwise_op(|a, b| a ^ b, x, y), then returns atomic_read_modify_write(agent, ta, index, value, &mut xor). This matches spec steps 1 and 2 in order, and the spec's ? propagation is preserved by returning the JsResult directly. There are no test-shaped branches, no swallowed errors and no fabricated values. The helpers come from crate::support::atomics and are not in the diff, so they must already exist (the build is ok). I could not read them, so I did not verify their internals (for example the ByteListBitwiseOp assert or the ToBigInt/ToIntegerOrInfinity ordering inside atomic_read_modify_write). The 4 remaining failures are not-implemented errors from Atomics.store used by the test harness, which is an honest limitation and not a defect in this change. The removed spec-text comment line "This function performs the following steps when called:" is cosmetic and does not change behaviour.
